text: End your _sadness_. Many are _sad_ seeing __your face__ like that ....
author: (c) 2022 Pak Bogor Putih

text: Everything is according to __His will__.
author: (c) 2025 H. Syaiful Anwar

text: __No need__ to change anything. You are ___perfect___, in the eyes of those who _love_.
author: (c) 2025 Lutfi Nur Syafira

text: Let those who __don’t like__ you be, __don’t change__ just for _them_. Life __only once__, __don’t follow__ others’ words.
author: (c) 2025 Bu Yus M3A

text: Everyone __surely__ has _flaws_ and _strengths_, has _faults_ and _virtues_. ___See their strengths, see their virtues.___
author: (c) 2025 Tn. Guru Ilmi Kerang

text: _Joke_ with __class__, not jokes that __invade privacy__.
author: (c) 2025 Ust. Muhammad Rusli

text: Stay _calm_ and _feel_ ... that __not everything can be told__.
author: (c) 2025 Lutfi Nur Syafira

text: Just _pretending_, so people think we’re ___happy___ ....
author: (c) 2025 Rahmat Tahalu

text: __Train your heart__ not to be _arrogant_ and __feel__ _superior_, and __train your eyes__ not to __look down__ on others.
author: (c) 2025 Tn. Guru Sanjaya Kerang Dayo

text: __Gratitude__ makes __us enough__, shaving makes us ___handsome___.
author: (c) 2025 Zoro Barbershop Kerang

text: It’s okay. No human is ___perfect___ ... perfection __belongs only to Allah SWT.__ _Thank you_ ....
author: (c) 2025 Pak Bejo Riyatno M3A

text: There is no such thing as __wrong path__, everyone _fights_ with ___their own destiny___.
author: (c) 2025 Thariq Batu Kajang

text: __Loving you__ is like the sea, tides will _always exist_, but the sea ___never changes taste.___
author: (c) 2025 Lutfi Nur Syafira

text: Learn from __mistakes__, not _from regrets._
author: (c) 2025 Muhammad Rama Danu

text: After all is done, I __don’t want__ to disturb anymore, because that is the ___promise___ I made _to myself_ long ago.
author: (c) 2025 Zaldy Firmansyah

text: ___Worship___ should not be _treated_ as a transaction, but make worship __a connection__.
author: (c) 2025 Fildhatul Hammi

text: We _may_ love them, but let them __love their choice__.
author: (c) 2025 Nur Melii

text: Act reasonably.
author: (c) 2025 Ahmedeeya

text: Reminds me of _the past_. We were __so close__ then ... but ___now ....___
author: (c) 2025 Atmin NOVY[A]

text: We were __not given__ food, ___don’t expect us___ to work.
author: (c) 2025 Hendry Noor

text: We will _never be perfect or right_, in the eyes of __haters__.
author: (c) 2025 Guru Wandi Tebru Paser Damai

text: Someone __cannot__ feel the same, if they are in ___a different position___.
author: (c) 2025 Ahmedeeya

text: Life is like playing __Angry Bird__. If we lose, there are pigs that __laugh__.
author: (c) 2025 Nurhadi-Aldo

text: I no longer _force_ communication. __Just inform__ me when needed, __find me__ when you need me.
author: (c) 2025 Intan Qurratu'ain

text: Your sleep is __too long__, until they _forget_, that you’re ___not a beginner___.
author: (c) 2025 Atmin Tiramisu Cake

text: Many _give examples_, but __few__ _become examples_. Giving examples is _easy_, but being an example is ___hard___.
author: (c) 2025 KH Zainuddin MZ

text: __Stay away__ if it’s _for your good_.
author: (c) 2025 Atmin NOVY[A]

text: And _come closer_ so you _know_ how ___evil I am___.
author: (c) 2025 Darken

text: _Thanks_. __Sorry__. ___Please___.
author: (c) 2025 Lite

text: If you __already know__, then ___go away___.
author: (c) 2025 Atmin NOVY[A]

text: __Speak__ to people _according_ to their __ability__. Speak to __educate__, ___not to judge___.
author: (c) 2025 Ust. Muhammad Rusli

text: _Face_ it with a smile. If you _want to join_, continue. If not, ___then fine___.
author: (c) 2025 Pak Jimmie M3A

text: No need to __celebrate__ Mother’s and Father’s Day, meet them _every day_, just __obey and honor__. Sometimes those who celebrate ___don’t truly love___ them.
author: (c) 2025 Danang M3A

text: __Regret__ is indeed _at the end_, if at the beginning it’s called ___registration___.
author: (c) 2025 Atmin NOVY[A]

text: __Ramadhan__ ... will forever be ___empty___.
author: (c) 2026 Ahmedeeya

text: __No need memory__ 500TB, to store someone ___precious___.
author: (c) 2026 Insyirah Wibrida

text: _Don’t forget_, __don’t forget the old ones__ ... just because of new ones, who just appeared ___in your life___.
author: (c) 2026 Rahmat Stecu

text: Never _use someone_ to __forget someone__.
author: (c) 2026 Atmin NovyA / sasaaa

text: Better to _count_ numbers than count __how many times__ your feelings were ___ignored___ by the one you love.
author: (c) 2026 UstadzM3A
